title: ioctl_key_export_private: outbuf not freed on copy_to_user failure
description: When copy_to_user fails after installing the private key in outbuf: outbuf is zeroed (correct), outbuf_len/drained are reset to 0 (correct), but state->outbuf remains non-NULL. The allocation persists until the next export attempt or fd close. The next export attempt will correctly free it via the stale-outbuf replacement path. But there is now a zeroed-but-not-freed allocation sitting in kernel memory until then. Suggested rewrite: after memzero_explicit, also kfree(state->outbuf); state->outbuf = NULL; state->outbuf_cap = 0; — match the complete cleanup pattern used in the stale-outbuf replacement code above.
